C0250.title: China's First Cross-Platform E-Commerce Image Theft Penalty
C0250.summary: In April 2021, market regulators in Changshu, Jiangsu Province investigated an online-store image-theft case. The merchant used software to clone product images, quality-inspection reports, detail pages, and packaging images from an original store through one-click store copying, using another merchant's high-quality pages to package its own store, alongside unlicensed operation and false promotion issues. Regulators found the conduct constituted passing-off and confusion under the Anti-Unfair Competition Law and imposed a RMB 50,000 fine.
